mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate earnings contraction and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises by >0.3pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a negative feedback loop in the equity market, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns, with the Rank IC falling below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by high industrial production growth, a deceleration in industrial production (INDPRO) signals the onset of a slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO deceleration in late-cycle expansion does not produce negative returns, with the 60-day forward return being positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 0.5% per annum signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases the cost of capital and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 100,000 jobs per month indicates a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000 jobs.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a monetary tightening that is not offset by labor market strength, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market stress
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising FEDFUNDS and UNRATE fails to predict negative returns, with the Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market correction regime, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1500 thousand units signals a weakening in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST decline in housing market correction does not produce negative returns, with the 60-day forward return being positive in more than 60% of such instances.
